116-2645-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-2645-3430-5233.description:

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-5254-6774.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

4365-6441-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

104-4050-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

4559-4740-5670-7824.notablePrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 10.
4559-4740-5670-7824.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasures, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinitely to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1309-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Salvager of Secrets from exile to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4399-4770-6626-6719.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2511-6461--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

891-2961-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2558-3000-5315-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cryptic Trilobite, adding {C}{C}.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-1409-5424.description:
Activate Sailor of Means by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sailor of Means enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sailor of Means.
Resolve the Sailor of Means trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

225-1409-2895-3756.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
225-1409-2895-3756.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1358-2073-2119.description:
Activate Seat of the Synod by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Seat of the Synod to become a creature until end of turn.
Seat of the Synod dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Seat of the Synod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
38-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Svella's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Icy Manalith token.

Repeat.

Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.

116-1486-1753-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.

Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2084-3908.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3908.description: Activate Spark Double by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Spark Double into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1497-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Wild Cantor.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.

Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Wild Cantor due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded three or more cards this turn, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1424-3957-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.

Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Angelic Chorus and gaining you 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.
